text_block_list.name: Oguri & Curren
text_block_list.text: Congrats on forming the "Grayish Club"—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I happened upon a lively scene where a total of nine horse girls had gathered in a classroom, creating quite a ruckus.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's right. Since we have the chance, we gray horse girls—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: We decided to create an exchange group that spans generations. It seems like it will serve as a useful forum for sharing information as well.

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text: The reason this club started in the first place, you know... Was Curren saying, "Let's get everyone with the same hair color together☆"♪

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text: ...I-It is an honor. To be granted even the humblest seat among you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The participating members were Oguri Cap, Biwa Hayahide, Karen Chan, and Chronogenesis. In addition—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: As for the representative of the club—unworthy though I may be, I shall take up the mantle, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Unworthy... wait, huh? McQueen-chan, did you get injured or something?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: My bad, McQueen... It's all 'cause I'm always chucking the Empire State Building at ya...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Are ya stupid?! She ain't hurt! "Unworthy" means, like... what was it again?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well, it's just a set polite phrase, so there's no need to sweat the meaning, right~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen, Hishi Miracle, Gold Ship, Tamamo Cross, and Seiun Sky. That brought the total to nine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Now then, before we deepen our fellowship—I would like to decide our membership numbers, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: It will be much more convenient for administrative purposes, after all. Um, as for how we determine the order...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Well obviously by "height order"! The shortest one gets Number 1...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wait, that's me! Who're ya callin' a shrimp?! My guts are huge, I tell ya!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ooh~ what a textbook setup and punchline.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hm, customarily speaking, alphabetical order would be standard, but...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Which means I would be Number 1. And Number 2 would be...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ehh, Oguri goes first again? You always stand out the most one way or another anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The discussion became convoluted, making it hard to settle. Then, after a while—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: It has finally been decided, desu wa! Grayish Club, line up at the training grounds!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Number 1, Tamamo Cross-san.
Number 2, Oguri Cap-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Number 3, myself, Mejiro McQueen.
Number 4, Biwa Hayahide-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Number 5, Seiun Sky-san.
Number 6, Hishi Miracle-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Number 7, Karen Chan...-san.
Number 8, Gold Ship-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
And Number 9, Chronogenesis-san!
That settles our lineup, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Now that the batting order is set, let's keep our heads in the game, desu wa!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Why the heck are ya talkin' like that?! Is this baseball?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I-I apologize, it was merely force of habit...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The order seemed to be settled safely, but...
choice_data_list: What is this order based on?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Starting with Tamamo Cross and ending with Chronogenesis. I couldn't quite figure it out...

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text: U-Um... Actually, you see. This order was proposed by me—

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text: It is the order in which we debuted in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text: The very first to debut was the Kansai Lightning, Tamamo Cross-san. From there on...

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text: All the way to me, Chronogenesis, the lineage of gray continues.

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text: I thought lining up in this order would allow everyone to truly appreciate racing history.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The lineage of gray. Indeed, looking at this lineup truly felt like looking back through history. It was a rather stylish arrangement, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Lineage... What's a... lin-ee-edge?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ah, indeed... It is white, soft, and delicious.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I wonder if there's a "silken lineage" tofu too~ Not that I really know.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's take this order right away and challenge the Giant Squid Rodeo! Quota is one minute each!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The chatter continued without pause. —The Grayish Club. It seemed like it was going to be quite a fun gathering.
